exact_total_duration.tooltip: Adjust the final output to the exact requested total duration.

audio_seam.tooltip: Auto corrects only decoded audio boundaries; video frames are never altered.

video_seam.tooltip: Analyze Only reports decoded video boundaries without changing them. Auto applies the validated transient and micro-flash correction. Auto 2 experimentally adds qualified exposure-ramp smoothing.

buffer_backend.tooltip: Auto keeps outputs up to 4 GiB in RAM only when physical memory has a safety reserve; otherwise it maps the final IMAGE to disk. Manual RAM and Disk-backed remain available.

driving_audio.tooltip: Connect the sampler Driving Audio output. When present, generated audio and Audio Seam are bypassed.

H3ContinuumAssembleSeamV35.description: V3.5 decoded-chunk assembler with Auto, RAM, or Disk-backed IMAGE storage, direct Exact Duration writes, and small-patch Video Seam.
